newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse extends losses.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse extends losses.

text.p: Shares on the Abidjan Stock Exchange extended their losses in the week to Friday, with the BVA All-Share index down 0.75 percent to 358.37 from 361.07 the previous week, the bourse's market report showed.
The "12 VB" blue chips index fell 0.58 percent to 246.02 from 247.46 points.
The bourse's 1996 cumulative rise remained impressive at 29.26 percent for the general index and 23.47 percent for the blue chips index.
The week's turnover was sharply lower at 37.1 billion CFA francs on 1,904 shares traded, compared with 217.5 billion CFA on 1,739 the previous week. ($=514 CFA)
